title: Molten Reverie
text:
Against fields of burning color, a muse emerges as both omen and apparition.

In the molten glow of gold, she stands sculptural in her Molten Shadow Dress, where black and gilded textures ripple like cooling lava, and her beauty forged between darkness and light. Her posture is severe, almost ritualistic, as if guarding a secret born from fire.

Then the world turns crimson.

Under the red horizon, she reappears transformed, like a fallen angel descending from some silent inferno. The Circle Jacket frames her like a dark halo while the Orbit Drape Skirt moves with a hushed gravity, tracing invisible constellations around her form. Beneath the haunting gaze of a Plague Mask, echoing the shadows of Medico della Peste, she becomes something mythic, half specter, half sovereign. Walking the thin line between ruin and radiance.
